title: FAR Module 3 · TBS 1

fields.label: 2. Transaction Price Allocated to Service Plan

html:
TASK-BASED SIMULATION

Multiple Performance Obligations

Allocate a contract's transaction price using relative standalone selling prices and determine revenue recognized.

Scenario

Nova Corp. enters into a contract with a customer for a total transaction price of $108,000.

The contract contains two distinct performance obligations:

Equipment Standalone Selling Price: $100,000
One-Year Service Plan Standalone Selling Price: $20,000

The equipment is delivered to the customer on January 1 and control transfers immediately.

The one-year service plan is provided evenly over the next 12 months.

Required

1. Transaction Price Allocated to Equipment
2. Transaction Price Allocated to Service Plan
3. Revenue Recognized on January 1
4. Monthly Service Revenue
explanation:
Step 1 — Relative Standalone Selling Prices

Equipment: $100,000 Service Plan: $20,000 Total: $120,000

Equipment represents:

$100,000 ÷ $120,000 = 83.3333%

Service represents:

$20,000 ÷ $120,000 = 16.6667%

Step 2 — Allocate Transaction Price

Equipment: $108,000 × 83.3333% = $90,000
Service: $108,000 × 16.6667% = $18,000

Equipment Allocation: $90,000

Service Allocation: $18,000

Step 3 — January 1 Revenue

Control of the equipment transfers immediately on January 1.

Revenue Recognized January 1 = $90,000

Step 4 — Monthly Service Revenue

The $18,000 service allocation is recognized evenly over 12 months.

$18,000 ÷ 12 = $1,500 Per Month

CPA Takeaway

  • Allocate transaction price using relative standalone selling prices.
  • Revenue allocated to equipment is recognized when control transfers.
  • Revenue allocated to services is recognized as the services are performed.
  • Cash received and revenue recognized are not necessarily the same amount at the same time.
